categories.main_business_segments: SMIC is a leading integrated circuit wafer foundry company primarily engaged in semiconductor wafer manufacturing and testing. It offers 8-inch and 12-inch wafer foundry services, design services, IP support, photomask manufacturing, and related one-stop services. The company also focuses on building an ecosystem platform to provide comprehensive integrated circuit solutions by collaborating with upstream and downstream industry partners.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: SMIC possesses a comprehensive integrated circuit wafer foundry core technology system with multiple technology platforms for 8-inch and 12-inch wafers. It develops advanced process nodes such as 28nm ultra-low leakage, 55nm high-voltage display, 65nm RF SOI, 90nm BCD, and embedded memory platforms. The company follows a rigorous R&D process including project selection, feasibility assessment, development, verification, and mass production. It emphasizes technology innovation, process optimization, and platform construction to meet diverse market demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SMIC serves global customers including integrated circuit design companies and IDM enterprises across various sectors such as smartphones, computers and tablets, consumer electronics, IoT and wearable devices, industrial and automotive electronics. Its customer base is diversified with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of total revenue. The company collaborates with leading enterprises in consumer electronics, automotive, IoT, industrial control, and AI sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: SMIC operates primarily in Mainland China with major manufacturing facilities in Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen, and other locations. It maintains international marketing and service offices in the United States, Europe, Japan, and Taiwan to support global customers. The majority of its revenue is generated from the China region (about 84.6%), followed by the US (12.4%) and Eurasia (3%).
categories.supply_chain_position: SMIC operates as a midstream semiconductor foundry in the integrated circuit supply chain, focusing on wafer fabrication and related technical services. It procures raw materials, equipment, software, and technical services from upstream suppliers and delivers processed wafers to downstream customers or their designated packaging and testing partners. The company also integrates upstream and downstream collaboration to provide comprehensive solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development through innovation-driven growth, focusing on advancing process technologies and expanding platform capabilities. It invests heavily in R&D (9.4% of revenue in 2024) with a professional team and structured innovation management. Key R&D projects include ultra-low leakage 28nm, high-voltage display, RF SOI, BCD, and embedded memory platforms. SMIC also emphasizes ecosystem building, industry chain collaboration, and green sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: SMIC generates revenue primarily through wafer foundry services, including manufacturing integrated circuit wafers based on various technology nodes and platforms. Additional revenue streams include design services, IP support, photomask manufacturing, and other related services. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with contracts and orders from global customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SMIC is one of the world's leading integrated circuit wafer foundry companies and the largest in Mainland China. It ranks second globally among pure-play foundries by sales revenue in 2024. The company faces intense competition from global industry leaders with more advanced technologies and higher market shares. SMIC focuses on technology innovation, capacity expansion, and ecosystem development to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SMIC achieved record sales revenue of RMB 57.8 billion, a 27.7% year-on-year increase, with a gross margin of 18.6% and EBITDA margin of 54.6%. The company’s total assets reached approximately RMB 353.4 billion, and wafer monthly capacity reached 948,000 8-inch equivalent wafers. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 3.7 billion, down 23.3% from the previous year, mainly due to decreased financial income. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory with ongoing capital expenditures focused on capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SMIC emphasizes its comprehensive technology platforms, strong R&D capabilities, and integrated one-stop service ecosystem as key differentiators. It offers a wide range of process technologies tailored to diverse applications including logic, power/analog, RF, embedded memory, and image sensors. The company’s internationalized operations, robust intellectual property portfolio, and close industry chain collaboration provide customers with reliable, localized, and innovative semiconductor manufacturing solutions. SMIC also commits to green and sustainable manufacturing practices.
